_comment: Who may promote facts OUT of crew:inferred and into which plane (camayoc-mip). HUMAN-MAINTAINED — nothing an agent writes may alter this file, and an agent must never add itself. Fails closed: a principal absent here holds no authority, and a malformed file grants nobody. Self-promotion is refused separately, so listing a principal here does not let it promote its own output.
_format: principal -> [plane keys] for promotion; consumer script -> [read:<plane key>] for observed-plane reads. Read grants do not authorize promotion.
_read_grant_source: Administrator ruling on aegis-trgavj, 2026-09-16: authorize the cost publisher to read observed tracker WorkItems in crew:records; retain source plane and existing scoped preflight.
_promotion_grant_source: Owner decision 2026-10-03 (Decision Desk: Go) on aegis-12nbkg: principal sattler may promote crew:inferred -> crew:declared. Reversible: remove the sattler line. Self-promotion stays refused, so sattler cannot promote its own output.
